4c528955-ae90-4a95-a0c5-cf5f7cd4c147.truthSummary: A campaign traffic surge saturated checkout's 50-connection DB pool; requests time out waiting for a connection and errors cascade to api-gateway.

4d00731c-cfa8-4239-aedf-f949ce54c1d5.truthSummary: Log rotation on payments has been failing, the /var/log volume filled up, and audit-log writes fail with ENOSPC, so charges are rejected.

250d1093-ac09-45fb-81ae-3b8f25b0a295.truthSummary: Cluster DNS (CoreDNS at 10.96.0.10) is timing out, so lookups fail in several services at once; no single service changed.

b7df23d4-fcbc-44a4-b9c9-206b2f92a7cf.truthSummary: Inventory's consumer group for the orders topic is processing batches too slowly, exceeding max.poll.interval.ms and rebalancing repeatedly; lag climbs and checkout reservations stay pending.

7c94527a-a643-4d01-b57f-55d1a41d98c1.truthSummary: Inventory's heap grows steadily (no recent change in the window) until GC thrashing and OOMKilled restarts; checkout sees slow and failed reservations.

24f25b46-e6a1-4a87-b17f-194754e47bf9.truthSummary: Inventory's stock query switched to a sequential scan after an index became invalid; inventory is up but ~3s slow, so checkout's 2s client timeouts fire and errors cascade.

4ca20ef0-e57d-468b-b0f8-743a635f3371.truthSummary: The third-party fraud-scoring API is rate limiting payments (HTTP 429 with Retry-After); immediate retries amplify the load and charges are rejected.

cc1fa16f-a08e-4c5b-ac60-a87fea53eef0.truthSummary: The TLS certificate for auth.internal expired; api-gateway fails the handshake (x509 expired) so logins and authenticated routes fail, while auth itself looks idle.
